# KNOX Implementation Prompt - EaglEs EyE

**Project:** EaglEs EyE
**Generated by:** KNOX (Know-xtractor-engine)
**Objective:** Reimplement the system described by EaglEs EyE using its extracted knowledge (workflows, domain model, interfaces).

---

## Technology Stack
- backend-language: TypeScript / JavaScript (Node.js)
- http-api: Vite Dev Server / Express Middleware
- 3d-geospatial-engine: CesiumJS (3D WebGL / WGS84 Globe)
- frontend: Modern Web / ES Modules + HTML5
- persistence: Redis (In-Memory Key-Value & Geospatial Store)

## Architecture Pattern: Layered Architecture
Layers: application, background, cli, client, configuration, domain, entrypoint, persistence, presentation, provider, tooling

## Implementation Order
1. Project scaffold + configuration + logging
2. Domain model (entities and relationships)
3. Persistence layer (Redis repositories)
4. API layer (routes, schemas, validation) - 63 endpoints
5. Application services implementing the workflows
6. Frontend / presentation layer (CesiumJS globe)
7. Background jobs (live data ingestion)
8. Tests (unit + integration)
9. Deployment + CI/CD (Docker + nginx)
